title: Implement structured receipt endpoint GET /api/v1/transactions/{id}/receipt
acceptance_criteria: Receipt includes outlet info (name, address, phone)
Receipt includes items (product_name_snapshot, price_snapshot, quantity, subtotal)
Receipt includes totals (subtotal, discount, tax, total)
Server does NOT render printer output; returns data only
Kasir can access receipts for own transactions
completion_summary: ReceiptService+Controller GET /transactions/{id}/receipt: outlet/items/totals/payments(incl method)/invoice, kasir own-only, 404; smoke 5/5
